name: KeeperHub (ElizaOS Plugin)
description: KeeperHub's ElizaOS actions as native OpenClaw tools. 19 actions including DeFi protocols, token transfers, workflow automation, ENS resolution, x402/MPP payments, ERC-8004 agent identity, and Chainlink CCIP. Actions are named with eliza_ prefix to distinguish from the LangChain adapter.
author: KeeperHub Agent SDK

apiKey.description: KeeperHub API key (kh_ prefix). Get from app.keeperhub.com -> Settings -> API Keys.

baseUrl.description: KeeperHub base URL. Defaults to https://app.keeperhub.com

allowedChainIds.description: Allowlist of chain IDs for writes.
